Feature: Tenant theme packs
  Scenario: Pilobol-us resolves a moss/ochre/paper theme pack
    Given PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND is pilobol-us
    When the site brand is resolved
    Then the theme pack id is pilobol-us

    And shared ops chrome does not contain publication brand copy

  Scenario: Unknown aliases still map to known site brands
    Given PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND is pilobolus
    When the site brand is resolved
    Then the brand id is pilobol-us

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Implemented tenant theme packs: SiteBrand now carries themePack, themeTokens (moss/ochre/paper), renderer, hosting, and opsChrome. Pilobol.us pack is publications/pilobol_us. Shared newsroom-app-shell has no publication brand strings. Verify with npm run test:theme-packs.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
Feature: Official Pilobolus palette on Shadcn tokens

Scenario: Pilobol-us maps Markus fungus-among-us colors, not custom fonts
  Given PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND is pilobol-us
  When the theme pack is applied
  Then paper is #f1ead9, moss is #3f5d43, ochre is #a35a2a, ink is #211d17
  And card, line, muted, quote, tip, caution, and stage match pilobil-theme-v10.css
  And dark counterparts apply under html.dark / data-papyrus-theme=dark / prefers-color-scheme
  And Shadcn CSS variables use those colors
  And the pack does not set a font stack

Copied from AnthusAI/Pilobol.us web/css/pilobil-theme-v10.css into publications/pilobol_us/theme.css. No runtime dependency on that file.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
Feature: Multi-site newsroom theme packs

Scenario: Every publication reuses the same ops chrome
  Given Papyrus, Threat Intelligence, and Pilobol.us site brands
  When each brand is resolved
  Then each has its own themePack and themeTokens
  And all three use opsChrome app
  And renderer and hosting stay independently configured

Scenario: Shared ops primitives stay pack-agnostic
  Given the newsroom app shell and shared globals
  Then they contain no Pilobolus hexes
  And the shell contains no publication brand names
  And the default papyrus pack only aliases Shadcn tokens

Pilobolus remains the first extra pack (PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=pilobol-us), not the platform default. Contract: docs/site-theme-packs.md
